text:
arjun: Heads up — we just saw a 7x spike in schema_rejects for the fncall sanitizer in eu-west during the midnight canary. Dashboard shows router fallback to degen-variant. Is this related to the strict validator rollout? https://redwood.internal/d/xyz :eyes:

sara: I noticed billing alerts for some Dedicated customers too. Are we sampling at 100% for the canary slice or was that reduced?

mike: I'm looking. Canary config says strict_validate=true for slice=soda-canary but sampling=10%. Logs show sanitizer returning REJECT_NONFATAL instead of a soft accept, which seems to trip the router.

jen: @mike can you paste the trace/log lines? product wants to know whether console should surface these as warnings vs hard errors — too much noise will confuse SEs. :warning:

mike: logs: `sanitizer:rpc fncall.validate req_id=abc123 result=REJECT_NONFATAL code=ENUM_MISMATCH field=action`
router: `route_override=degen-variant reason=sanitizer_reject`

arjun: that explains it — router treats NONFATAL as fatal for routing policy. We originally chose correctness over availability for canary. I want to propose: treat NONFATAL as soft_fallback signal (don't force degen) so we avoid unnecessary degrades.

sara: product is +1 on soft fallback UX. But need clarity on billing and customer-visible labels — do we still bill full token cost if we return primary vs fallback? Need a short note in console.

mike: technical caveat: switching semantics may slightly increase risk of bad outputs for some prompts. Proposal: change router to convert REJECT_NONFATAL -> fallback_score=0.2 and expose a per-customer rollout toggle in console. Gate the change behind a canary. Also will emit telemetry tag `sanitizer_fallback_reason`.

alice: +1 for the telemetry tag. Request a dashboard panel: percent of requests in slice that hit soft_fallback vs hard_reject, plus per-model latency and token delta. That'll help us correlate quality regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: patch/eng-platform/sanitize-routing v1.3 by @mike — scheduled in 10m. CI: green. :shipit:

mike: Plan for the patch: if reason == NONFATAL and validator_score >= 0.8 -> keep primary; else mark soft_fallback. Adding metrics: `fncall.sanitizer.soft_fallback` and `fncall.sanitizer.hard_reject`. Will also add `sanitizer_fallback_reason` tag.

sara: UX ask: add an alert rule in console that fires when soft_fallback > 5% for 5m for production accounts, with quick link to run the repro prompt set. Also a brief hover explanation of what soft_fallback means.

arjun: sound plan. @mike after deploy can you post a quick howto for SEs on how to toggle the fallback behavior per-customer? Also open a follow-up to decide billing attribution for soft fallbacks.

mike: will do — PR + howto thread after the deploy.

jen: thanks team. Oncall will watch the canary for the next 30m and we'll roll back if we see hard_reject rate increase.
